description: Register an event. Registers a new event name and (optionally) its typed properties. Only `name` is required.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the event.

folder.description: Optional folder name grouping items in the dashboard. Alphanumeric, `_` or `-` (no `/`). Part of the SDK lookup key (`<folder>/<name>`).

listToken.description: REQUIRED. The `listToken` returned by the most recent `metrics_events_list` call. It proves you listed existing metrics events and confirmed this one doesn't already exist before creating it. Call `metrics_events_list` first if you don't have a fresh token.

name.description: Event name. Starts with a letter, digit, or `_`; letters, digits, `_`, `-`, `.`; max 128 chars. Immutable after create — this is the handle metric queries reference.

properties.description: Typed properties declared on the event. Defaults to an empty list.

items.description: One typed property declared on a catalogued event.

required.description: Whether the property must be present on every emitted event.

type.description: Value type of the property as recorded on the event.

name: metrics_events_create
